ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy 49a7631b1ddb (Profiling with firepit) modified currency-service/k8s/configmap.yaml and removed the key rate_limit_rps from the Kubernetes ConfigMap currency-service-config. After the rollout, the environment variable RATE_LIMIT_RPS was absent from the running pod. The service fell back to an unlimited (0 RPS) rate limit, causing it to flood the upstream exchangerates API which enforces a 50 RPS per-client limit. The upstream responded with HTTP 429 and opened its circuit breaker against the currency-service IP, making all currency conversion requests fail with HTTP 500/503.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Patch the Kubernetes ConfigMap: kubectl patch configmap currency-service-config -n production --type merge -p with data.rate_limit_rps set to 45. 2. Trigger a rolling restart: kubectl rollout restart deployment/currency-service -n production. 3. Confirm RATE_LIMIT_RPS=45 appears in pod logs on startup and upstream error rate drops below 1%. 4. Long-term: add a startup probe or init container that validates required env vars including RATE_LIMIT_RPS are present and non-empty before the main process starts, to prevent silent fallback to unlimited mode.
